paragraphs.text: Livonya Silone is a legendary Human Warrior from Dominaria .

Livonya Silone is a light-skinned human warrior who became a legend on Dominaria. She has light skin and long black hair but her exact nature is a matter of mystery. Nothing about her is known for certain, with only rumors surviving of her having unearthly stealth and of making unholy alliances. At one point in her life, she fights goblins and dual-wields two swords.
Given that Livonya's lifetime is unknown, and Legendary creatures from the Legends set are from many points in time, she may be long deceased, currently alive, or even yet to be born.
